links.outcome: LLM CPT code output accuracy against NASS answer key
links.effect: Exact match: Gemini 65%, GPT-4o 55%, Claude 40% (p=.28); GPT-4o and Claude 0% exact match for lumbar fusion constructs.
links.quote: Gemini 1.5 Pro achieved an exact match rate of 65%, followed by ChatGPT-4o (55%) and Claude 4.6 Sonnet (40%), though these differences in overall performance were not statistically significant (p=.28).

links.outcome: Financial variance from LLM coding errors (overcoding/unbundling)
links.effect: Mean net revenue overcharges of +$75.60 (ChatGPT) and +$104.07 (Claude) per case; Gemini -$2.16 per case.
links.quote: In contrast, ChatGPT and Claude demonstrated a strong tendency toward overcoding and high financial volatility, resulting in mean net revenue overcharges of +$75.60 and +$104.07 per case, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Human supervision of LLM-generated medical billing (CPT) codes

screen.reason: Evaluates the baseline zero-shot accuracy and financial variance of three LLMs on clinical coding vignettes without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
